B5TBADYvw2Ue.text: This process can result in changes to the atom's atomic number or mass number, potentially changing its identity as an element

NSeu2M5ZsRu9.text: - Alpha particles (helium nuclei) are emitted from the nucleus, reducing the mass number by 4 and the atomic number by 2 (unless the original atom was a non-stable element which in that case it could lead to different elements),

pTtrBgfYmDsM.text: - Beta particles are either positrons or electrons, which are emitted from the nucleus when a neutron is converted to a proton (and so an electron and an antineutrino are emitted) during beta emission process, and when an electron is converted to a neutrino and an antielectron during the beta plus process
